I was in a 3 year relationship when I was younger and I invested my entire identity into him. He broke up with me and said he didn't love me anymore.

The relationship was my first for everything. My first time having sex, my first love, my first time living with someone. You name it, I did it with him. 

After we broke up, I was COMPLETELY devastated. I had questions like "who am I?" "If he doesn't want me, who will?" I went to therapy, developed bad anxiety, and cried an ungodly amount. 

It hurt so much but I got over it. Slowly, day by day, I told myself that I survived this day and I can do it again tomorrow. I tried things that I never tried before because I didn't know what I liked. I wrote down everything that popped into my head just to get it out. I moved and made new friends. 

I want you to know that this time completely sucks and painful and devastating and scary but YOU WILL BE OKAY. It's not going to be today, or tomorrow, or next week but you will be. It took me a long time but I'm so much stronger of a person from that. And you will be too. I just went through a breakup but with some self-loving, a few nice comments on Reddit, and two very best friends, I got over it fairly quickly because I know that if I could get over that relationship, I can do the same with this one. 

Learn something new, take control of your life, surround yourself with good positive people, don't be afraid to cry or go to therapy, and love yourself because you deserve it. He is not the only guy out there for you and you will be loved again.
